versions.changelog: Initial release: add a full-page dashboard widget that connects performers through shared videos. Explore random pairs, long chains, paths across years, or a path to the library's most connected performer; choose either endpoint, limit chains to duos, and set the maximum number of degrees.

name: Six Degrees of Johnny Sins
description: A full-page dashboard widget that finds the shortest chain of shared videos between two performers.
author: MidnightRider
